assumptions: Massless circular coplanar ports, central gravity only, dimensionless units.
All spacecraft initially docked to A at epoch zero; phase scan excludes duplicate 2pi.
Initial loading finishes at 0.25; each intermediate stop has one 0.25 service.
Cargo loads/deliveries occur at service completion; arrival burns precede unloading.
Vehicles stay attached to each circular port while waiting; no stationkeeping cost.
Each parcel loaded once from finite assigned A stock; no refueling or free capture burns.
Fuel consumed by rocket equation using current dry+cargo+fuel mass at each impulse.
Parallel candidate has two independent tugs and assumes noncontending A service.
Completion is max final A return time; fuel is summed consumption, hardware is tug count.
All scores minimized; dominance tolerance 1e-10; initial fuel .6 on every tug.
Greedy earliest feasible departure after readiness; deliberately no discretionary holds.
experiment: Five finite prograde exact Hohmann route candidates over 72 third-port phases

illustration_selection.criterion: First prefer >=2 nondominated one-tug families with >=10% time span and >=.01 fuel span, then any families meeting those spans. Maximize (maxTime/minTime-1)*(maxFuel-minFuel) within the qualifying front. Greedily choose three separated by >=6 phase samples.

limitations: Offline analytic experiment, not the app fixture, a joint handoff, or evidence of fun.
Arbitrary C radius and authored-content phase search, not an unbiased incidence estimate; five candidates only, no global optimum claim.
No vehicle design/capacity limits, port contention, production, uncertain execution, or assists.
Finite complete itineraries only; no infinite repeat or sustained throughput claim.

schema.illustrations: Compact score/path summaries for the three explicitly selected phases.
schema.independent_verification: DOP853 endpoint and signed circular-matching checks for all six distinct directed legs in the primary witness.
schema.phases: Compact sweep: all 360 candidates retain scores, vehicle paths, feasibility, Pareto flags and delivery times; ledgers are computed and validated internally but omitted here.
schema.primary_detailed_witness: All five candidates at the first selected phase, including every vehicle's cargo/fuel/event ledger and transfer legs.
